Name: Maggie BRD Complete
Description: Complete Bard event profile based on Jasper's public-duty structure and checked against BossMod priorities. Opener stays enabled; Save CD is manual only; 3/6/9 songs, DoTs, beneficial AoE and automatic interrupt remain enabled.

Events.Name: Second Wind Recovery
Events.Description: Uses Second Wind once personal HP falls near 60 percent.

Events.Name: Warden's Paean (Self)
Events.Description: Cleanses self when Warden's Paean can help.

Events.Name: Warden's Paean (Party)
Events.Description: Cleanses party members when Warden's Paean can help.

Events.Name: Out-of-Combat Reset
Events.Description: Returns Bard ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state.

Events.Name: Zone Reset
Events.Description: Bard defaults are reapplied after changing zones.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset
Events.Description: Bard defaults are reapplied after a wipe.

Events.Name: Nature's Minne TB
Events.Description: Uses Nature's Minne on the main tank for incoming tankbusters.

Events.Name: Nature's Minne Emergency
Events.Description: Uses Nature's Minne on a low party member during recovery windows.

Events.Name: Head Graze Cast Stop
Events.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Head Graze when in range.

Events.Name: Arm's Length Self-Guard
Events.Description: Triggers Arm's Length only when you are stationary, pressured, and several mobs are on you.

Events.Name: Damage State Guard
Events.Description: Maintains Bard songs, burst, AoE, DOT, Apex, utility, and support-helper toggles in combat so imported or held toggle states cannot strand the job in a passive state.

Events.Name: Pack Damage Release
Events.Description: Maintains standard Bard AoE, DOT, songs, burst, and Apex helper toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Conditions.Name: Second Wind <= 65%
Conditions.Description: Self HP threshold for earlier Second Wind recovery.

Conditions.Name: Lowest Ally <= 60%
Conditions.Description: Lowest ally threshold for Nature's Minne support.

Logics.Name: Second Wind
Logics.Description: Uses Second Wind once personal HP falls near 60 percent.

Logics.Name: Reset Toggles
Logics.Description: Returns Bard ACR settings to their normal out-of-combat state, including AoE, DOT, song, and support toggles. ForceAOE remains manual.

Logics.Name: Nature's Minne TB
Logics.Description: Uses Nature's Minne on the main tank for incoming tankbusters.

Logics.Name: Nature's Minne Emergency
Logics.Description: Uses Nature's Minne on a low party member during recovery windows.

Logics.Name: Head Graze Interrupt
Logics.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Head Graze when in range.

Logics.Name: Arm's Length Emergency
Logics.Description: Uses Arm's Length as self-defense when stationary below 70 percent HP with two or more mobs on you.

Logics.Name: DPS Toggle Safety
Logics.Description: Maintains Bard songs, burst, AoE, DOT, Apex, utility, and support-helper toggles in combat so imported or held toggle states cannot strand the job in a passive state.

Logics.Name: Multi-Target AoE Release
Logics.Description: Maintains standard Bard AoE, DOT, songs, burst, and Apex helper toggles on 2+ enemy pulls while leaving ForceAOE manual.

Items.Name: Raid Mit
Items.Description: Uses Troubadour and Nature's Minne for raidwide damage support.

Items.Name: Minne
Items.Description: Uses Nature's Minne for tankbuster and low-ally recovery support.

Items.Name: Cleanse
Items.Description: Uses Warden's Paean for self and party cleanse support.

Items.Name: Self Guard
Items.Description: Uses Second Wind and Arm's Length for personal emergency recovery.

Items.Name: Interrupt
Items.Description: Uses Head Graze on interruptible casts in range.

Items.Name: DOTs
Items.Description: Manages Bard DOT toggles for normal uptime.
